svg.aria-label: Which traffic crosses the rack boundary at 1, 2, 4, and 8 racks
svg.text: What crosses the rack boundary as you add racks
Data parallelism exists at every size. What changes is which traffic has to leave the rack.
Tensor-parallel group: 8 GPUs, stays on NVLink
NVLink: 3.6 TB/s per GPU inside a rack · ConnectX-9: 1.6 Tb/s (~200 GB/s) per GPU between racks — roughly 20x less
